human_summary: This educational material covers the BI-RADS® Mammography Lexicon, focusing on breast density categories and associated terminology. It includes detailed classifications of breast findings, assessment methods, and the clinical significance of breast density for both mammographic accuracy and cancer risk assessment. The material is presented with visual examples of each breast density category.
illustrations_note: The material includes 16 figures showing visual examples of each breast density category (A-D) in both digital mammography (DM) and screen-film mammography (SM) views. These visual examples are essential for understanding the practical application of breast density classification. Manual image-task authoring is recommended.

not_recommended.reason: Sequence tasks are not recommended for mass characteristics as they don't require ordering information.
Open answer is not ideal for testing specific classification details like calcification types.
Test questions are not ideal for assessing understanding of the BI-RADS lexicon structure as it requires hierarchical understanding.
Click text is not the best format for assessing the impact of breast density on mammographic accuracy as it requires explanation.
Illustrations are present. Image-based tasks are not auto-generated in this flow; consider manually creating 2-4 image tasks in the editor for visual recognition/classification.

recommendations.rationale: Multiple choice questions effectively test classification knowledge and specific numerical data like odds ratios and regulatory updates.
Click text tasks effectively test identification of correct statements among options, particularly for classifications and regulatory requirements.
Open answer questions allow students to demonstrate conceptual understanding in their own words.
Click words tasks are suitable for identifying incorrect statements about factors affecting breast density variability.
Sequence tasks are ideal for testing understanding of hierarchical structures and procedural knowledge.

warnings: Visual content is present but text-only generation cannot assess image recognition capabilities. Image-based tasks should be created manually if visual recognition is an important learning objective.
